about: The five designs of https://indi-gupte.agenticcells.site: the same facts, laid out five ways.

designs.name: The Briefing
designs.idea: A diplomat's briefing note on cream paper: him and his own words first, every fact with a numbered note to its source.
designs.leads_with: His photo, his own line from his post, the two buttons and three sourced figures; then his work in pictures and the ten-day strip

designs.name: Lingua
designs.idea: A polyglot edition: his languages lead, and every section is titled in English, Italian and French.
designs.leads_with: His three languages, each with the ask and the section titles in that language

designs.name: Front Page
designs.idea: A newspaper front page about his week, from one of PrompTugal.news's editors.
designs.leads_with: The masthead with its two ears ("Wanted: work experience" and "Reply via LinkedIn"), then the lead story about his week with his pictures in black and white, and his week in dates in the sidebar

designs.name: Agent Console
designs.idea: The operator's view: a team of 27 AI agents, 23 running, and 277 commits from 3 to 13 November 2026.
designs.leads_with: A green status line, then the operator panel with three sourced figures beside his team of agents drawn as one figure; then his week as a log

designs.name: The Card
designs.idea: A business card, front and back. In his words: "I designed our business cards".
designs.leads_with: His card on a dark desk, front and back: his photo, name, "Looking for work experience" and LinkedIn on the front, "What I bring" on the back; everything else folded under More
